respuesta.razonamiento: Merged visual and narration readings into a unified architecture graph. UserConsumerWeb (b0) matches the narrated user uploading files to S3 (b1). S3 triggers StepFunctions (b2), which orchestrates MediaConvert (b3), Rekognition (b4), Transcribe (b5), Comprehend (b6), and DynamoDB (b7). Spoken mention of 'lambdas' between Step Functions and DynamoDB is merged into the direct Step Functions -> DynamoDB edge drawn on the board. Spoken 'Reach Engine' / 'orchestration engine' maps to the drawn EC2 (b8) and EKS (b9) compute nodes receiving data from DynamoDB.
respuesta.nombre: Reach Engine Media Processing and Analysis Pipeline
